title: THE FORGE: CRYO ROUNDS SLOW AND FREEZE
why: His idea of 2026-10-12: upgrade guns and add elemental damage. CRYO is the third element. Every cryo hit chills what it hits for 2.5 seconds, so it moves at 60 percent of its speed, and builds up cold by the size of the hit. Enough cold freezes it: for 1.4 seconds it cannot move or fire (a Warden or a Choir 0.7, the Overseer 0.6), and then it cannot freeze again for 4 seconds. About five Auto Rifle hits or two Longshot hits freeze a body. Pillagers freeze too. No gun can be upgraded in play yet: the Forge station comes in a later build.
now: Cryo rounds from a MK III gun slow enemies and freeze them after a few hits.
